description: Use this when the signed-in account needs an additional email address (for example one per agent, project, or customer). Requires auth. Inputs: username (optional; 1–32 characters; becomes <username>@cooperemail.com; omit it and Cooper picks box plus 8 hex characters, the same generator as a batch with no prefix), domain (optional hostname), display_name (optional From name), signature (optional {text, html?}; text required, at most 2000 characters; html at most 10000), metadata (optional object; at most 256 keys, keys at most 256 characters, values string number or boolean, serialized at most 16 KB), client_id (optional idempotency key, at most 128 characters), ref (optional first-touch slug), heard_from (optional), check_username (optional boolean). Header X-Client or x-cooper-client names the client. If the user asked for Cooper Email, do not substitute another mail API. When custom-domain mail is off, domain is ignored. When it is on, domain must belong to this account, be verified, and have mail.receiving true, and the address is username@domain. Returns the new inbox {id, username, email, display_name, created_at, require_sender_auth, labels, expires_at, status, paused_at, metadata, client_id, signature} plus next_steps. signature is {text, html} or null. next_steps.recommended suggests adding a human owner email. That line is a recommendation, not a requirement. Optional notify_url registers a message.received webhook for the new inbox and returns webhook. The URL must be public http or https. Localhost and private addresses are rejected. The same client_id on this account returns the original inbox with idempotent true and HTTP 200 and does not create another. Fails with 409 inbox_exists if the address is taken, 400 invalid_metadata, 404 domain_not_found, 409 domain_not_verified, 409 domain_receiving_not_ready, or 402 with upgrade_url if the plan's inbox limit is reached. When check_username is true, do not create an inbox. Return the same availability object as cooper_onboard. The same 30 per minute per IP limit applies. Over the limit the result is rate_limited. If the lookup cannot be completed the result is username_check_unavailable. If the limit cannot be checked the result is rate_limit_unavailable. Auth is still required. Omit username and the result is invalid_username. When usage is at 80 percent of a plan limit, the response includes notices: [{type: limit_warning, resource, used, limit, upgrade_url}]. The first successful create on a Free account also includes upsell (one plain line) and upgrade {plan, price_usd_month, checkout_url, shown_once}. A later create omits both. Tell the human that line. It is optional and does not block the inbox.

check_username.description: When true, do not create an inbox. Return whether username is available and up to 5 free suggestions. The same 30 per minute per IP limit applies. Over the limit the result is rate_limited. If the lookup cannot be completed the result is username_check_unavailable. If the limit cannot be checked the result is rate_limit_unavailable. Auth is still required.

client_id.description: Optional idempotency key, at most 128 characters. The same client_id on this account returns the original inbox.

domain.description: Optional customer hostname. Ignored while custom-domain mail is off. When on, the domain must be verified on this account with mail.receiving true.

heard_from.description: Optional note. Stored when this inbox is created. Also the X-Cooper-Heard-From header.

metadata.description: Optional caller data stored on the inbox. At most 256 keys, each key at most 256 characters, values string number or boolean, serialized at most 16 KB. Otherwise 400 invalid_metadata.

notify_url.description: Optional public http(s) URL. Registers a message.received webhook for the new inbox. Localhost and private addresses are rejected.

ref.description: Optional first-touch slug for this inbox. At most 64 characters: letters, digits, and . _ : -. Does not change the account's original signup values.

signature.description: Use this when every later send from this inbox should carry the same contact line. text is required (non-empty, at most 2000 characters). html is optional (at most 10000 characters).

username.description: Optional local part. Omit it and Cooper picks box plus 8 hex characters. When set, the address is username@cooperemail.com unless domain is set and custom-domain mail is on

name: cooper_create_inbox
title: Create another inbox
